name: B10-0030/2024 (The Left) – Situation in Venezuela
title: Resolution on the situation in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for calm and transparency after Venezuela's disputed presidential election of 28 July 2024. It asks Venezuela's election authorities to publish all voting records, as the law requires, so everyone can check the result. It wants all people arrested in the unrest released and a national dialogue opened. It also says past outside interference, such as sanctions and recognising a rival leader, made tensions worse. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a law.

- The election authority must publish all voting records; this affects voters and both camps.
- All people held since the unrest should be freed; this affects over 2,400 detainees.
- The Parliament sends its position to the European Union and Venezuela's government; no binding change follows.
